plan.notes: Source: official NECC program page 'Computer Science Associate Degree' (necc.mass.edu; last site crawl 2026-09-30) and its matching smartcatalogiq catalog entry 'CIS: Computer Science, Associate in Science Transfer Concentration' (necc.smartcatalogiq.com). Catalog year 2026-2027 is the current NECC catalog (Effective Fall 2026 per the catalog home). Degree's true official name: 'Associate in Science degree program in Computer and Information Sciences: Computer Science.' Transcribed 2026-09-30 from the official 'Recommended Course Sequence/Pathway CIS Computer Science, Associate in Science' term-by-term tables; no courses invented. Catalog states 'A minimum of 60 credits are required for graduation' and the sequence prints 'Total Credit Hours: 60'; the sequence sums to exactly 60 with 3-credit program electives (program electives are officially 3-4 credits each, so student totals can range 60-64 — modeled at 3 here, the catalog's printed minimum). The catalog lists 'Courses with Prerequisites: CIS113, CIS115, CIS154, CIS160, CIS225, CIS252, ENG102, MAT251, MAT252' but does NOT publish per-course prereq chains, so all prereq lists are left empty rather than inventing chains. Elective advice carried into choice_note fields verbatim (transfer advice for Merrimack/UMass Lowell). Course codes rendered with a space (e.g. 'CIS 160') following seed convention; catalog prints them as 'CIS160'. NECC also publishes a separate Web Development Concentration sequence — this file is the standard/transfer CS pathway shown on the main Computer Science program page.
